text.hi: एक लड़का रोज़ अपना नाश्ता एक भूखे भिखारी को दे देता था। बड़ा होकर वही लड़का नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस बना! पहले नए शब्द।
text.hinglish: Ek ladka roz apna naashta ek bhookhe bhikhaari ko de deta tha. Bada hokar wahi ladka Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose bana! Pehle naye shabd.
text.en: A boy gave his breakfast to a hungry beggar every day. That boy grew up to be Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose! First, new words.

steps.meaning: a poor person who asks others for food or money
the first meal of the day
steps.example: I have milk and bread for breakfast.

exampleMeaning.hi: मैं नाश्ते में दूध और ब्रेड लेता/लेती हूँ।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Main naashte mein doodh aur bread leta/leti hoon.

steps.example: This is your share of the cake.

exampleMeaning.hi: यह केक में तुम्हारा हिस्सा है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Yeh cake mein tumhara hissa hai.

steps.example: He wondered how poor people could be.

exampleMeaning.hi: उसने सोचा कि लोग कितने ग़रीब हो सकते हैं।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Usne socha ki log kitne gareeb ho sakte hain.

steps.example: Keep your books on the bookshelf.
